speaker: Penny

speaker: Penny
text: I still don't get it.

text: Meow. I'm the Doppler effect.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, if that is some sort of learning disability, I think it's very insensitive.

text: Close! Why don't you just tell people you're a zebra?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why don't you just tell people you're one of the seven dwarves? Yes, well, I'm the Doppler effect.

text: Oh, no. That's Penny's ex-boyfriend.

text: What?

text: What do you suppose he's doing here, besides disrupting the local gravity field?

text: If he were any bigger, he'd have moons orbiting him.

text: Oh, snap. So I guess we'll be leaving now.

speaker: Leonard
text: Why should we leave? For all we know, he crashed the party and Penny doesn't even want him here.

text: You have a backup hypothesis?

text: Maybe they just want to be friends.

text: Or maybe she wants to be friends and he wants something more.

speaker: Leonard
text: Then he and I are on equal ground.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes, but you're much closer to it than he is.

speaker: Leonard
text: Look, if this was fifteen thousand years ago, by virtue of his size and strength, Kurt would be entitled to his choice of female partners.

speaker: Sheldon
text: And male partners, animal partners, large primordial eggplants, pretty much whatever tickled his fancy.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yes, but our society has undergone a paradigm shift. In the information age, Sheldon, you and I are the alpha males. We shouldn't have to back down.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why don't you text him that and see if he backs down?

speaker: Leonard
text: No. I'm going to assert my dominance face to face.

text: Face to face? Are you going to wait for him to sit down, or are you going to stand on the coffee table?

speaker: Leonard
text: Hello, Penny. Hello, Kurt.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, hey guys. You having a good time?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Given the reaction to my costume, this party is a scathing indictment of the American education system. Yet another child left behind.

text: Oh, you're a zebra, right? What are you supposed to be, an elf?

speaker: Leonard
text: No, I'm a hobbit. A hobbit is a mortal halfling inhabitant of Middle Earth, whereas an elf is an immortal tall warrior.

text: Because he's neither tall nor immortal, and none of us could be the Flash.
